description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the TheoryExam ASP.NET Web Forms page. It manages loading theory questions from a database, displaying them to the user, handling user login validation, and submitting answers to the database. Additionally, it includes navigation controls and a timer for exam duration.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the TheoryExam page, handling page lifecycle events, database interactions, navigation, and exam timer management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; checks user session, loads questions from database, sets exam timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns the full name of a course given its ID.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles submission of answered questions, storing answers, updating course queues, and marking the exam as taken.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates countdown timer display, and indicates when time has expired.
